verdict.rationale: Twilio documents AI-powered transcription and analysis of voice interactions, call recording, and extracting intelligence from conversations into persistent context. A hands-on user also reports using voicemail transcription delivered to a webhook. However, AI-generated summaries are only implied by "analysis", and attaching them to a conversation record is not shown as an out-of-the-box feature rather than something developers wire up themselves. Missing for 10: explicit AI call-summary capability, documented attachment of transcripts and summaries to a conversation thread, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration of live-call transcription.
